title: Colby GPU Cluster: Native SwiftUI macOS Menu-Bar App Visualizing Slurm GPU Node, Job and Queue State on the Colby College HPC Cluster — Robert Zhou
description:
Native SwiftUI macOS menu-bar app that renders the Colby College HPC Slurm GPU partition as a pannable, zoomable isometric city: free, allocated and unavailable GPUs per node, running jobs with elapsed and wall-clock limits, the pending queue with scheduler reasons, and reservations. Reads Colby's public GPU status page or any colby-gpu-status/1 JSON feed, or polls Slurm over SSH.

Single Swift package, no third-party dependencies, 340+ unit tests. Companion to Robert Zhou's ml-experiment control plane for retained GPU leases, vLLM and llama.cpp serving on H200, RTX PRO 6000, A100, L40S and L4 nodes.

Author: Robert Zhou, Colby College. Portfolio: robertzhou.dev. Project write-up: https://robertzhou.dev/work/ml-experiment-slurm/. Source: github.com/bobzhou-source/colby-gpu-cluster.
